title: Negative transfer amount
notes: Expected result "System handles it appropriately" is not testable and the plan defines no correct behaviour, so no expectation was invented. Observed in code: AccountService.transferAmount does not check the sign, so -50 moves 50 from the recipient to the sender. Needs a product decision on the expected result (for example: reject with a message).
